name: Word bomb
summary: A pass-the-bomb word game: a drawn bomb with a lit fuse sits on one face in a ring, carrying three letters; the holder types a word containing them before the fuse burns down and the bomb flies on; words from the group's list score double, a pop costs a heart, last one with hearts wins.
useWhen: study break, five minutes, no more
quick word game for the orgo gc
something fast to play between problem sets
word game where chem words count double
dontUseWhen: a slow game with categories (use letter-sprint)

chunks.description: Letter chunks the bomb carries, 2 to 4 capital letters each, e.g. 'ENE', 'OL'

bonus.description: Words that score double, e.g. vocabulary from the class the chat is studying

turns.description: Turns so far in order: who held the bomb and the word they played, or popped: true if it blew up on them

tries.description: Tries that did not count, e.g. a word already said
